text: After twelve lessons of tests, CI, and orchestration, Finance says what they said at the start: the number still doesn't match. We don't assume the new number is wrong -- we check it.
Finance's count is a snapshot of one exact date. The dashboard's count is anyone active on any day that month. Two honest answers to two different questions, not a bug.
Re-run the comparison at the same grain Finance used, straight from the governed intermediate model, and the numbers match exactly -- the business logic is proven correct.

But the report shows revenue right next to that headcount. Summed by hand from raw billing, it's far lower than the mart reports. One spot-checked invoice shows why: it's matching thirty rows, not one.
The headcount was never the real problem. Next: reading the exact line of SQL responsible for that thirty, and fixing it for good.
